title: Co-nudge kind-tag fix leaves the find query's email-without-sms clause with only genuine sends to exclude — exhaustion still dead for phone-less referees
evidence:
+      // r3 (W3): the co-nudge is addressed to the APPLICANT — its entry is
+      // tagged so the delivery-failure find can exclude applicant-addressed
+      // sends (a bounce of the applicant's address must never exhaust a
+      // referee row with a fabricated referee_contact_invalid).
+      json.array([co_nudge_entry(outcome, now_iso)], fn(e) { e })
...
+fn co_nudge_entry(outcome: ChannelOutcome, at: String) -> json.Json {
+  json.object([
+    #("at", json.string(at)),
+    #("channel", json.string(messages.channel_name(outcome.channel))),
+    #("outcome", json.string(messages.outcome_name(outcome.outcome))),
+    #("detail", json.string(outcome.detail)),
+    #("kind", json.string("co_nudge")),
+  ])
+}
detail: The kind tag fully solves the co-nudge exclusion, so the find query's sibling email-without-same-at-sms clause now excludes only genuine sends: a phone-less (or post-correction cleared-channel) referee's email-only invite never matches a bounce, so its second failure never exhausts — no unreachable, no referee_contact_invalid.
recommended_fix: Drop the email-without-sms clause from the find query now that co-nudges carry kind, and pin an integration test with an email-only delivered entry bouncing to exhaustion.

title: A matched entry with a MISSING at key is treated as a genuine post-correction failure — the never-guess gate still guesses
detail: send_is_malformed is false when the matched entry lacks an at key (NULL ~ regex yields NULL, NOT NULL is NULL, COALESCE makes it false), while matched_send_at is '' — so the r4 N8 'stand down instead of guessing' gate guesses genuine and exhausts.
recommended_fix: Make the flag three-state: missing at must stand the event down like a malformed at, with the fallback path (no send-ref match) the only route that treats '' as genuine.

detail: A crash between the exhaust UPDATE and the stamp leaves the row unreachable with no referee_contact_invalid and no audit; the find query never selects a terminal row again, so no redelivery can retry the stamp — the signal is permanently lost, not just delayed.
recommended_fix: Stamp inside the same transaction as the exhaust terminal, or add a backfill/repair sweep for unreachable rows lacking the referee_contact_invalid signal.
